title: Kyle Juszczyk fined for offensive demonstration for "imitation of chugging a beer"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Kyle Juszczyk fined for offensive demonstration for "imitation of chugging a beer"
sources.description: There are plenty of beers being sold at NFL stadiums and advertisements for them being shown during games, but the NFL has apparently drawn the line at players pretending to drink them on the field.
